description: This file provides a Serializer class for serializing and deserializing HTTP responses and requests, used for caching purposes within the pip package vendor code.

classes.name: Serializer
classes.description: A class responsible for serializing and deserializing HTTP request and response objects, supporting versioning, Vary headers, and different cache formats.

methods.name: bytes dumps( self, request: PreparedRequest, response: HTTPResponse, body: bytes | None = None, )
methods.description: Serializes a PreparedRequest, HTTPResponse, and optional body bytes into a bytes object for caching.

methods.name: bytes serialize(self, data: dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Serializes a dictionary into a bytes object using msgpack.

methods.name: HTTPResponse|None loads( self, request: PreparedRequest, data: bytes, body_file: IO[bytes] | None = None, )
methods.description: Deserializes bytes data into an HTTPResponse object, based on the version encoded in the data.

methods.name: HTTPResponse|None prepare_response( self, request: PreparedRequest, cached: Mapping[str, Any], body_file: IO[bytes] | None = None, )
methods.description: Constructs an HTTPResponse object from cached data if Vary headers match.

methods.name: None _loads_v0( self, request: PreparedRequest, data: bytes, body_file: IO[bytes] | None = None, )
methods.description: Handles legacy v0 cache format, treats as a cache miss.

methods.name: HTTPResponse|None _loads_v1( self, request: PreparedRequest, data: bytes, body_file: IO[bytes] | None = None, )
methods.description: Handles v1 cache format, deprecated for security reasons.

methods.name: HTTPResponse|None _loads_v2( self, request: PreparedRequest, data: bytes, body_file: IO[bytes] | None = None, )
methods.description: Handles v2 cache format, which is obsolete.

methods.name: None _loads_v3( self, request: PreparedRequest, data: bytes, body_file: IO[bytes] | None = None, )
methods.description: Handles v3 cache format, treated as a miss due to encoding issues.

methods.name: HTTPResponse|None _loads_v4( self, request: PreparedRequest, data: bytes, body_file: IO[bytes] | None = None, )
methods.description: Handles v4 cache format, the current supported version, deserializes data using msgpack.
